svg.aria-label: ULTRA-SATISFACTORY: a flat-colour Amiga-style intro. Heavy black capitals spell ULTRA SATISFACTORY on two waves across hot pink, mustard and green bands cut into stepped factory skylines, with a Space Elevator silhouette in front of a sun of orange and violet rings.
